stories.headline: Retail Investing Opens Up to AI Assistants
stories.body: Scalable Capital became the first bank in Europe to open its investment platform directly to outside artificial intelligence assistants on Aug. 25, letting customers connect ChatGPT, Claude or Grok to a real brokerage account holding actual money, Scalable Capital said in its announcement. stories.headline: Nonbank lender finds niche in airport concession business
stories.body: Los Angeles-based Lendistry recently received a $100 million credit facility from East West Bank to support loans to airport concession operators.

stories.headline: Kalshi partners with brokerage Alpaca as it tries to build its international audience
stories.body: The prediction market platform and the financial infrastructure and brokerage startup are working to get Kalshi's event contracts to global investors.
